nodes.title: The Operator's final reply is checked for unsupported ₹ amounts and durations, a tap with no card, and change claims; each check corrects at once and repairs once
nodes.rationale: Bench r4: the past-tense claim check fired once in 107 runs, falsely, and missed 'Tap to confirm' with no card, a misread duration and ₹9,608-24,021 for ₹9.61-₹24.02. Figures are held to the turn's tool results and the member's message; InrMilli fields count as thousandths.
nodes.reverse_if: The number check corrects true replies in the bench or in real threads more than rarely (e.g. figures derived by arithmetic the member asked for)

nodes.title: After a NOT DONE write, a write to another tool the member's words do not point at is held in code
nodes.rationale: Bench r4: after a refused brief.edit, a retry moved the agent onto a custom test-only stack nobody asked for. Wording alone did not stop guesses.
nodes.reverse_if: Legitimate multi-step requests get held because the word match misses the tool (then use the plan's declared steps as the scope)

events.details: Operator fixes for bench r4: reply checks (numbers, tap without card, claims without the infinitive false positive, confirm-first nudge); retry scope guard and wording; fixFor reads agent.config.schema for draft paths and names limits; deployment.split on /agents and contact.list on /campaigns; campaign.estimate display strings; bench grader camp-estimate needs the estimate's own figures. tests/operator-bench-r4.test.ts 9 tests; 7 integration tests fail on the previous code, the 2 pure check tests cover the new check module (the old claim function flags the r4 false positive: shown). Gates on a fresh DB: tsc clean, 529/533 (0 fail, 4 skipped), ui-contract strict 177/177. Not verified on real models until the bench re-run.
